title.zh-CN: 波士顿马拉松 2027/2028 男子资格标准（按年龄组）
title.en: Boston Marathon 2027/2028 men's qualifying standards by age group

unit.zh-CN: 分钟（资格赛净成绩上限）

note.zh-CN: BAA 官方 2027/2028 标准；女子与非二元标准在每个年龄组均比男子慢 30 分钟（如 18-34 为 3:25:00）。达到标准只获得申请资格，录取还受名额与录取线限制。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: Official BAA 2027/2028 standards; women's and non-binary standards are 30 minutes slower than the men's standard at every age band (e.g. 3:25:00 at 18-34). Meeting the standard only permits applying; entry also depends on field size and the cut-off. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.

title.zh-CN: 波士顿马拉松：历年资格录取线（低于标准的幅度）
title.en: Boston Marathon: qualifying cut-off margin by year

unit.zh-CN: 秒（需比本年龄组标准快出的时间）
unit.en: seconds faster than the age/gender standard required

note.zh-CN: BAA 官方「未录取资格者」历史表：录取线是申请者需低于本年龄组标准的时间幅度，不是赛道关门时间。2023 年录取线 0:00，即达标者全部录取。本站自制图，非官方赛道剖面。
note.en: From the B.A.A. non-accepted qualifiers history: the cut-off is the amount faster than one's age/gender standard needed for acceptance, not a race finish limit. In 2023 the cut-off was 0:00, i.e. all qualifiers were accepted. Self-made chart, not an official course profile.
